widget.name: Duplicate Finder & Merge
widget.short_description: Find and merge duplicate contacts, companies and leads
widget.description: The widget finds and merges duplicate contacts, companies and leads in amoCRM. Flexible search rules (field combinations with AND/OR), value normalization (phones, emails, names), duplicate checks while working in a card and prevention of new duplicates. This is a scaffold (stage 2): a frontend widget with no business logic; search, merge and the backend will arrive in the next stage.

card.title: Duplicates
card.merge_confirm: Merge this record into the current card? The duplicate will be deleted (can be rolled back).
card.merge_pick_master: Choose the record to keep — the other is merged into it and deleted (can be rolled back).
